final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.APTT) AS avg_aptt, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_aptt) AS sex_avg_aptt, AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) AS A FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_averages) SELECT S.SEX, S.sex_avg_aptt, S.A, S.A - O.B FROM sex_averages AS S CROSS JOIN overall AS O WHERE O.B IS NOT NULL AND S.A > O.B
